title: Data Structure Notes
body:
Below are notes relating to data structures. Some are resources for optimizing common data structures, others are for understand concurrency, and some are notes on interesting data structures that are rarely used in practice. Hashmaps:
  • Optimizing Open Addressing
  • Concurrent Hash Table Designs
  • GPU Hashmaps with Cuda
  • Concurrent Hash Tables: Fast and General(?)!
  • Swiss Tables Design Notes
EGraphs:
  • egg: Fast and Extensible Equality Saturation
  • Fast Decision Procedures Based on Congruence Closure
Union-Find:
  • Philip Zucker: Groupoid Annotated Union Finds
  • In Search of the Fastest Concurrent Union-Find Algorithm

Recently I've been very into reading old papers on all the interesting data structures theorists like Dan Willard came up with in the 1980's. There will be some notes related to that. More to come as I read more! I wish I could directly include all of these papers but some of them are paywalled :(

Y-Fast-Trie:
  • Log-logarithmic worst-case range queries are possible in space Θ(N)
  • C++ Implementation of Y-Fast-Trie
  • Fast Local Searches and Updates in Bounded Universes
